item.title: Trump may have lost but don’t bet Democrats can fix the economy
item.description: There’s not much they can do over the next couple of years to alleviate angry voters’ stress over prices It was the economy, again. item.title: What’s the point? Ten years after the Paris treaty, are climate talks getting anywhere?
item.description: Its key temperature goal has been missed but experts say the agreement is still proving a vital moral compass for progress It was a curious way of conducting negotiations. Ahead of the 2025 climate summit, in the Amazonian port of Belém last year, the Brazilian hosts had taken off the table the issue that most had assumed would be at its heart: concrete plans from each country laying out exactly what they would be doing to cut their greenhouse gas emissions.
